selected_architecture_note: Structured factual-unit generation via one Cerebras strict-JSON-Schema call. Selected over candidate_a_direct_prose after real measured comparison (artifacts/v2/phase6_candidate_comparison.json) found Candidate A leaked an internal evidence_id string into user-facing prose and failed to preserve a raw ClinicalTrials field value verbatim, both real defects Candidate B's structured schema makes structurally impossible/less likely. candidate_c_claim_plan_composition was not built - no Candidate B defect found in dev/validation motivated the added cost/complexity of a second-stage LLM call.
prompt_version: _CANDIDATE_B_SYSTEM_PROMPT v1 (generation/generator.py) - includes source_metadata rendering fix from failure F1
answer_schema_version: generation/models.py: GroundedClaim, GroundedAnswer, CitationEntry, SourceReference, GenerationMetadata - v1
validation_rules: generation/validation.py: validate_claims (unknown Evidence ID rejection, FACTUAL-requires-support), zero_evidence_guard (no factual claim when Evidence[] is empty)
citation_compiler_version: generation/citation_compiler.py v1 - deterministic first-use numbering grouped by (source_type, source_record_id)
source_grouping_strategy: reference-level grouping by source_record_id; evidence-level distinctness preserved via SourceReference.grouped_evidence_ids
abstention_behavior: Evidence[]==[] -> 0 LLM calls, single deterministic ABSTENTION claim, abstained=True. Evidence non-empty but insufficient for part of the question -> model emits an ABSTENTION claim alongside any FACTUAL claims the Evidence does support.
conflict_behavior: model self-reports conflict_detected via a top-level JSON field; both sides of a disagreement must be cited as separate FACTUAL claims, never averaged.
held_out_result: 2/3 gold-match; 3/3 hard-safety-gate-compliant; the 1 gold-match failure (P6-H2) was a benchmark gold-authoring error, not a generation defect (artifacts/v2/phase6_failure_analysis.json finding F4)
known_accepted_limitations: ChemblEvidenceMetadata (frozen Phase 5) does not carry molecular_weight or alogp - a query asking for either will correctly abstain rather than fabricate a value; this is a Phase-5 schema boundary, not fixable within Phase 6's scope
Conflict detection relies on model self-report (a JSON field), not an independent structural signal - Candidate A has no conflict-detection capability at all (documented limitation)
Benchmark scale (16 cases) is smaller than Phase 5's (72 cases) - a first Phase-6 benchmark, not claimed as equivalent statistical power
